latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Arabic AI video editing skill.

- Edit Arabic-language videos with AI-assisted cuts, captions, and effects using a cloud backend.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, and WebM files up to 500MB; outputs 1080p MP4.
- Automatic setup with free credits for new users; secure cloud processing, no installation required.
- Natural language prompt routing enables functions like editing, exporting, uploading, and credit checking.
- Clear workflow for session setup, video editing, and export, including error handling and helpful user feedback.
- Optimized for fast processing of short clips and iterative editing.
